# SH Elevate Financial Group Inc.

Last updated: 2026-09-13

> Canadian tax and accounting firm based at 36 Lee Centre Drive, Scarborough, Ontario (M1H 3K2), next to Scarborough Town Centre. We prepare personal (T1) and corporate (T2) tax returns, register and file GST/HST, incorporate businesses in Ontario or federally, and provide bookkeeping and year-round CRA-compliant tax planning. In-person across the GTA; remote video, secure document sharing, and CRA e-filing for clients in Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, and Alberta.

## Primary services

- Personal tax (T1): employees, families, students, newcomers, self-employed / gig workers. Typical deadline April 30; self-employed filing deadline June 15, but any balance owing is still due April 30.
- Corporate tax (T2): small and medium CCPCs. Return due six months after fiscal year-end; tax owing usually due two or three months after year-end. Small business deduction on the first $500,000 of active business income.
- GST/HST: registration at the $30,000 small-supplier threshold (or voluntarily earlier), RT account setup, monthly/quarterly/annual filing, input tax credits. Ontario HST is 13%.
- Business incorporation: Ontario provincial or federal (CBCA), NUANS name search, articles, Business Number, CRA program accounts (RC / RT / RP).
- Bookkeeping and year-round tax planning, including salary-versus-dividend modelling and CRA review / audit support on returns we prepared.

## Where we serve

In person: Scarborough and the Greater Toronto Area.

Remote across Canada, with named coverage in:

- Ontario: Toronto, Hamilton, London, Sudbury, Thunder Bay, Timmins, Sault Ste. Marie
- Newfoundland and Labrador: Corner Brook and province-wide
- Nova Scotia: province-wide
- Prince Edward Island: province-wide
- Alberta: Grande Prairie

## Tax guidance

Tax rates, eligibility and deadlines depend on the tax year and circumstances. Use the official-source sections in the linked guides; these are general information, not an assessment of an individual taxpayer.
